shortBulletSummary: Crypto Markets Rebound: Bitcoin and Ethereum show modest gains; Solana surges, yet overall sentiment remains in "Extreme Fear" due to persistent ETF outflows.
Hawkish Fed Policy: Federal Reserve's "higher-for-longer" interest rate stance continues to pressure crypto, eliminating 2026 rate cut hopes.
US-Iran Diplomacy vs. Military Stance: Renewed US-Iran talks initially boosted BTC, but Iran's military readiness signals introduce new geopolitical uncertainty.
Retail Interest Returning?: Global crypto search volume rebounded in June, suggesting a potential return of retail investors.
